key_findings: Multiple (but not single) dental pulp injuries produced persistent orofacial mechanical allodynia for 70 days with astrocyte activation (GFAP up, GS and GLT-1 down), increased apoptosis markers and reduced GAD65 in the trigeminal Vi/Vc transition zone.
Twelve EA sessions produced analgesia lasting 49 days after treatment and reversed MDPI-induced changes in GFAP, GS, GLT-1, cleaved caspase-3, Bax, Bcl-2 and GAD65.
